#419 · Sea Weasel Pokémon

Floatzel

Water

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Floatzel is a Water-type Sea Weasel Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 33.5 kg. It evolves from Buizel. Its highest base stat is Speed (115), with a base stat total of 495.
